prompt:
Use case stylized-concept. Produce the ORIGINAL gameplay-world illustrated cover artwork, no lettering, for a fictional open-world Shanghai life-sim called Modu Life. Paint a near-square landscape 5:4 composition. The requested visual language is unmistakably the hand-inked character cover illustration of Rockstar's GTA V loading screens and GTA VI official character posters: editorial poster art with bold irregular charcoal contours, hard cel-shadow shapes, cut-paper silhouettes, extremely intentional color separation, handsome semi-realistic adult facial anatomy, chunky gouache brushwork in gradients and some very fine screen print grain. Rich highly saturated coral, mango, bubblegum purple and clear mint/teal. Bright and exuberant urban summer dusk, sticky and alive. This must look hand illustrated, a premium graphic novel dust jacket, with clearly visible line work and controlled simplified planes. Absolutely NO photo, no photoreal skin, no film still, no generic airbrushed painterly smooth faces, no hyperreal 3D render, no subdued black rain scene, no cute anime or chibi.

Make a striking classic Grand Theft Auto-style comic cover montage with exactly three big panels and thick confident black diagonal seams about 1% of canvas width, strongly asymmetrical and art-directed. The main panel takes the left 58% and all the height. In this main panel a 24-year-old Shanghai woman with messy black ponytail, a worn cobalt blue overshirt over a warm cream ribbed T-shirt and a bright vermilion suitcase, stands in a bold low-angle three-quarter composition, eyes looking confidently left of camera, quietly amused expression, one hand on the suitcase handle, holding a dark phone in the other, waist-up and head within the image. Make her silhouette and dark hair very readable, face with real personality and cheekbones, strong golden rim highlights, directional graphic shadows, not a fashion model. Keep her whole face inside the middle x=22–47% of the overall image. Shanghai's distinctive real Oriental Pearl Tower and stepped Bund facades read instantly behind her, with a huge graphic apricot sun and exuberant fuchsia peach sky like a screenprinted city postcard. Do not turn Shanghai into Miami; no palm trees, no American streets.

The right two panels are fully contrasting Shanghai micro-stories. Upper-right panel: a young Chinese adult courier in an ochre yellow helmet and indigo jacket speeds past a narrow lilong lane on a turquoise electric scooter with a strapped bright delivery crate, low diagonal dynamic angle, lane and turquoise shadows recede behind him. Lower-right panel: sharply-dressed young Shanghai man in an ivory shirt and a warm mauve jacket turns his head across a Huanghe Road banquet table, one amber glass in hand, under intense warm red Chinese restaurant window light, graphic silhouettes of dishes and glassware. High energy tension between very different livelihoods and their wildly different stakes. Keep the three views distinct and all three heads visible. Secondary art smaller and less sharp than main woman, visual center right across all three scenes. Tone: swagger, hustle, humor and bright city heat, a scene you want to step into. Cover is edge-to-edge art, no margins, no external frame, no lettering, no title, no UI, no words or legible signage, no existing GTA characters or logos, no violence, no guns. Give the finished image clean weighted black contours and advanced illustration craft all the way to the edges.
